# anthropic_compliance_role (Data Source)

Reads one custom RBAC role of a linked organization together with its permissions. Requires `compliance_api_key` (a Compliance Access Key) or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying the `read:compliance_org_data` scope; Admin API keys are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_compliance_role" "reviewer" {
  organization_uuid = "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"
  id                = "rbac_role_01ExampleRoleId0000000"
}

output "reviewer_actions" {
  value = data.anthropic_compliance_role.reviewer.permissions[*].action
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Role id (`rbac_role_...`).
- `organization_uuid` (String) Organization UUID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Role description; may be null.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `permissions` (Attributes List) Permissions granted by the role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Permitted action (open vocabulary).
- `resource_id` (String) Organization id or connector id when present; null otherwise.
- `resource_type` (String) Resource type (`organization`, `connector`, `connector_tool`, `connector_scope`, `all_connectors`).
